sources.t: Code powers for Smarter Technologies Group Limited
sources.f: Published 9 July 2026; Ofcom opened a consultation on applying Electronic Communications Code powers to Smarter Technologies Group Limited.
sources.g: A Code-powers consultation is regulatory evidence, not proof of deployment or current service at a premises.

sources.t: Code powers for G.Network Holdco Limited
sources.f: Published 10 June and updated 27 July 2026; the consultation was closed pending a statement.
sources.g: Regulatory status does not establish exact-address orderability.

sources.t: Electronic Communications Code consultations and final directions
sources.f: The official Ofcom infrastructure index reports this collection was updated 27 July 2026.
sources.g: A consultation and direction index is discovery evidence, not parcel connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Register of persons with Electronic Communications Code powers
sources.f: The official register listing persons granted Code powers was updated 27 July 2026.
sources.g: Presence on the register does not prove a network has been built or activated at a parcel.

sources.t: Telecommunications Market Data Update
sources.f: Updated 23 July 2026; Ofcom reports Q1 2026 fixed and mobile market aggregates, including 29.4 million fixed broadband lines.
sources.g: National market aggregates do not establish current service availability at an address.

sources.t: Funds for Liabilities enforcement programme
sources.f: Published 16 July 2026; Ofcom opened an enforcement programme concerning providers' funds-for-liabilities duties.
sources.g: An enforcement programme is not coverage or orderability evidence.

sources.t: Pine Media Funds for Liabilities investigation
sources.f: Published 16 July 2026; Ofcom opened an investigation into Pine Media's compliance with Regulation 16.
sources.g: Compliance investigation status does not prove service at a premises.

sources.t: Internetty Funds for Liabilities investigation
sources.f: Published 16 July 2026; Ofcom opened an investigation into Internetty Ltd's compliance with Regulation 16.
sources.g: A financial-compliance investigation is not exact parcel service evidence.

sources.t: Trooli Funds for Liabilities investigations
sources.f: Published 16 July 2026; Ofcom opened investigations into two Trooli group companies under Regulation 16.
sources.g: Corporate compliance status does not establish network reach or activation.

sources.t: Cambridge Fibre Networks Funds for Liabilities investigation
sources.f: Published 16 July 2026; Ofcom opened an investigation into Cambridge Fibre Network Ltd under Regulation 16.
sources.g: Regulatory investigation evidence cannot be promoted to current address availability.

sources.t: ADR schemes performance
sources.f: Updated 23 July 2026; Ofcom publishes Q2 2026 performance indicators for telecoms ADR schemes.
sources.g: ADR operational performance is consumer-redress context, not broadband coverage evidence.

sources.t: North Shropshire Project Gigabit contract
sources.f: Updated 14 April 2026; BDUK records a contract change placing remaining North Shropshire premises into an Openreach call-off.
sources.g: A contract change and planned scope do not establish current retail service.

sources.t: Derbyshire Peak District Project Gigabit contract
sources.f: Updated 10 April 2026; BDUK records termination of the FullFibre contract and inclusion of the area in an Openreach call-off.
sources.g: Termination and replacement planning are not exact-address orderability evidence.

sources.t: Closure of Third Release Phase 2 public reviews
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the official page records closure of the Third Release Phase 2 public reviews.
sources.g: A closed public review and intervention planning do not prove live connectivity.

sources.t: Closure of Release 1B Public Review RFI
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; BDUK records closure of the Release 1B review covering Suffolk, Norfolk, Shropshire and Hampshire.
sources.g: Review closure and proposed procurement are not current parcel service evidence.

sources.t: Buckinghamshire Hertfordshire East Berkshire closure notice
sources.f: Updated in June 2026; Annex C records a redesigned contract covering around 6,000 premises.
sources.g: A revised intervention and contract scope is not proof of service at any specific address.

sources.t: Hampshire Lot 27 Public Review closure notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the closure notice provides OMR, public-review and intervention-area outcomes.
sources.g: Outcome maps and classifications require current exact-address validation.

sources.t: Norfolk Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the official consultation page added Annex C changes and outcome materials.
sources.g: Postcode lists and review classifications do not establish present retail availability.

sources.t: Buckinghamshire Hertfordshire East Berkshire Public Review
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the consultation page records Annex C updates and public-review outcome material.
sources.g: Public-review evidence remains planning context rather than exact parcel truth.

sources.t: Code powers for Digital Infrastructure Ltd
sources.f: The official Ofcom page records the consultation and final direction applying Code powers to Digital Infrastructure Ltd.
sources.g: A final Code direction is regulatory authorisation, not evidence of active service at a parcel.
